name: URL Short tool by Shorterm – Simple, Fast & Private
author: dimitrisevis

sections.description:
Looking for a reliable URL Shortener?

URL Shortener by Shorterm is the lightweight solution to create, manage, and track short URLs directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Unlike complex plugins, Shorterm focuses on speed and privacy. It allows you to use your own domain for short links (e.g., yoursite.com/go/offer), giving you 100% control and ownership.

✨ Why is this the best URL Shortener?

  • Performance: Zero bloat. It won’t slow down your website.
  • Privacy: Your data stays on your server. No third-party dependencies.
  • Simplicity: Create a short URL in seconds.

🟢 Free Features (Included)

  • Instant URL Shortener: Generate random short links instantly.
  • Link Manager: View and edit all your short URLs in one list.
  • Affiliate Cloaking: Mask long affiliate links to look professional.
  • SEO Redirects: Uses 301 redirects to protect your ranking.
  • Click Counter: See total clicks for every link.

🚀 Shorterm PRO (Advanced Features)

Upgrade to Shorterm Pro for powerful marketing tools:

  • Custom Slugs: Create branded links like yoursite.com/black-friday.
  • Advanced Analytics: Track Referrers, Browsers, Locations, and Devices.
  • Excel Export: Download click data for analysis.
  • Password Protection: Secure access to specific links.
  • Link Expiration: Auto-expire links after a date or click limit.

View the Live Demo: Try Shorterm Pro

💡 Use Cases

  • Affiliates: Turn amazon.com/ref=12345 into yoursite.com/amazon.
  • Social Media: Share clean, trackable links in your bio.
  • Marketing: Track how many people click your email offers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shorterm folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP, or upload the zip file through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Shorterm” menu in your sidebar and click “Add New” to create your first link!
sections.faq:
Why use a WordPress URL Shortener?

Using your own domain for short links builds trust with your audience. It also ensures your links never break if a third-party service (like Bitly) goes down or changes its pricing.

Does it affect site speed?

No. Shorterm is optimized to be extremely lightweight. It runs minimal queries only when a link is clicked.

Can I customize the short URL text?

The Free version generates random short keys. To customize the text (slug) to something readable (e.g., /my-promo), you need Shorterm Pro.

Is it compatible with Elementor/WooCommerce?

Yes, it works perfectly alongside all major WordPress plugins and themes.
